title: Solo Leveling, Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Pop-Up Store to Open in New York in August
content: Ize Press announced on Friday it will open a limited-time pop-up store dedicated to Solo Leveling and Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint in New York City from August 14 to August 30. Named System Sync, the pop-up will be located at 238 E 6th Street in Manhattan and is timed to coincide with Anime NYC on August 20-23.

title: 5 Great Anime Side Characters Who Secretly Stole The Show
content: The anime industry has produced many great series with amazing casts of main characters . These main characters are what essentially define an anime’s narrative. However, having only the main characters at the center all the time, despite how compelling they are, can become repetitive and boring.
